Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR NRCM recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the YP-II Under ITMU Cell post at ICAR NRCM is scheduled for 16th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the YP-II Under ITMU Cell post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a M.Tech in Biotechnology, M.Sc in Biotechnology, M.Sc in Life Science, or M.V.Sc. in Veterinary Science to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the YP-II Under ITMU Cell position?
faq.answer: The age limit for this post is between 21 years and 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the YP-II Under ITMU Cell post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the YP-II Under ITMU Cell post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the YP-II Under ITMU Cell post at ICAR NRCM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the ICAR NRCM located?
faq.answer: The ICAR National Research Centre is located in Medziphema, Nagaland, with the pincode 797106.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. Specific documents like ID proof and educational certificates are essential.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.
